subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate **ANTONYM** of the given word.

Distinctive
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e.** 'Alike'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Distinctive"** refers to something that is unique, easily recognizable, or having characteristics that set it apart from others.(विशिष्ट)
 
• **It implies** that the object or feature stands out and is easily distinguished.
 
• **"Alike,**" means having similarities or being similar in nature or appearance.
 
• **It denotes** a lack of distinctiveness or uniqueness.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: ***'Alike'.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of other options and their Hindi meanings:

 
 
• **Parallel:** It means side by side and never meeting or intersecting.(समांतर)
 
• **Constant: **It means continuous, steady, or unchanging.(नितांत) 
 
• **Different:** It means not the same or dissimilar.(अलग)
